summary: Agencia Comercial Spirits Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting its wholly-owned subsidiary AGCC Singapore Pte. Ltd. entered a five-year AI computing cloud services agreement with a digital financial services customer. The agreement may generate up to ~US$374.4 million in gross service fees over 60 months, contingent on deployment, acceptance, and usage. This is a commercial contract, not a special-situation event. No deal terms are specified. The filing is a routine current report of a material agreement; no special-situation category applies.
